title: CS2 in Javascript Demo
author: TimeForsaken5275
selftext:
AI made the game with three.js. It was an optimization nightmare.  
Currently optimizing even more for low-end chromebook players.

comments.author: deezwhatbro
comments.body: Fps enthusiasts think of net code and proper server auth, rollback and replay on dysnc type of optimizations. Something tells me you haven’t even considered that facet yet.

replies.author: TimeForsaken5275
replies.body: I’m a solo dev, so I don’t have 2k a month for servers rn

replies.author: deezwhatbro
replies.body: I understand, but it’s going to be really hard bringing in a user base for an fps that can be hacked trivially. Client relay based fps is just going to be cheaters galore.

replies.author: TimeForsaken5275
replies.body: It will be inline/authoritative server architecture soon

replies.author: deezwhatbro
replies.body: So it’ll be that implementation but also you can’t afford a server? Not sure which it is, but I wish you the best of luck. As a CS player, I wouldn’t touch this with a pole.

comments.author: vitalsyntax
comments.body: What is your goal here? Your literally just straight 1:1 ripping CS.

replies.author: deezwhatbro
replies.body: He thinks CS is what you see, what you get. An ungodly amount of thought went into managing net code packet latency and net desyncs.

replies.author: TimeForsaken5275
replies.body: That is planned to be added obviously

replies.body: My brother in christ cs2 exists already. Why are you doing this? You are burning water, you are burning resources on this. You arent even  learning anything from it you cannot use this. The AI is just being abused for something you'll never be able to ship.

replies.body: I already shipped it, it’s making money

replies.body: Making money of someone else's IP? How low can you go? Hope your game and account gets banned.

replies.body: Someone else’s IP that’s literally already free to play with…

replies.author: Every-Prize4720
replies.body: they just need to optimize it even further you know. when it is better optimized than cs players will come in droves

comments.author: Strong_Buddy7657
comments.body: How are you doing the animations and models and what not.  Is ai making those or are you ripping them from the game files

replies.author: true-heads
replies.body: They are pretty clearly ripped directly from some sort of open source repo somewhere 1:1. Like I dont front when someone tries to make something with AI, but this really doesnt make sense, cant really learn anything from this, cant use it as their own project of any sort, so its kinda just wasting money. Also runs a good chance of getting a cease and desist from Valve if he ever publishes the source or tries to get other people to play it publicly.

comments.author: Ok_Top9254
comments.body:
I'm already making a CS "clone" myself, but just my 2 cents: Do NOT copy the CS visuals if you plan to release the game, especially with any paid elements or ad revenue. 

Valve owns IP on everything in the game from skins to maps. God forbid you pulled any code from the leaked csgo repos. Do a proper research on this or ask claude/chatgpt to give you a lawyer type analysis at minimum.

There was a guy making a csgo browser port this year in late July from the leaked 2016-17 code base I believe, and he got a DMCA from Valve within a week. Valve DOES keep tabs about this stuff. Do not go into this with "they don't care".

replies.author: hugomcjohnson
replies.body: How would it make money? You are coyping a game thats literally free and works
